title: Relative clauses: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: I don't like people ___ are rude.
That's the man ___ wife works with my mother.
items.explanationEs: La mujer de ese hombre: whose (cuyo).

items.statement: The film that we saw was great.
items.explanationEs: Sin comas, that vale para cosas.

items.statement: Paris, that is the capital of France, is beautiful.
items.explanationEs: Con comas no se usa that: Paris, which is the capital of France, is beautiful.

answers: The cake you made was delicious.
items.explanationEs: El relativo objeto se puede quitar (the cake that you made), pero no se repite it.

items.text: The hotel ___ we stayed was near the beach.
items.explanationEs: El lugar donde nos quedamos: where.

items.text: Do you know anyone ___ can fix my computer?

items.sentence: The car who I bought is red.
items.explanationEs: Para una cosa, which (o that), no who.
